spec.freeze_kind: prospective: written before any EXP-026 measurement; no measurement exists
spec.historical_question_verbatim: Why does the 80B behave differently from the 30B (requirement section 56, question 10)?
spec.historical_hypothesis_verbatim: [HYPOTHESIS] Competing explanations, to be discriminated: (a) routing concentration (smaller EWS fraction); (b) smaller slices (440-704 KiB vs 930 KiB) raise queue depth per byte; (c) the 80B is bookkeeping-bound (commit/decommit/lock 56% of its I/O bucket) rather than read-bound.

b.wording: (b) smaller slices (440-704 KiB vs 930 KiB) raise queue depth per byte

c.wording: (c) the 80B is bookkeeping-bound (commit/decommit/lock 56% of its I/O bucket) rather than read-bound

d.source: pre-existing RQ-009 candidate list (OPEN_QUESTIONS.md); not part of the historical EXP-026 hypothesis quotation

explanandum.beta: beta_m = (ln s_P1 - ln s_P2) / (ln x_P1 - ln x_P2), s = gen tok/s (cell median of 3 VALID untraced launches at 4 generation threads), x = budget / F
explanandum.delta_beta: delta_beta = beta_80b - beta_30b (point value from the cell medians)
explanandum.envelope: for each model, beta is computed for every pairing of one P1 value with one P2 value (3 x 3 for performance cells, 2 x 2 for diagnostic cells); the envelope is [min, max] of those betas
explanandum.REPRODUCED: beta80 < beta30 and the envelopes do not overlap (max env80 < min env30)
explanandum.REVERSED: beta80 > beta30 and the envelopes do not overlap (min env80 > max env30)
explanandum.NOT EVALUABLE: a P1 or P2 primary cell of either model fails eligibility (fewer than 3 of 3 VALID)
explanandum.historical_direction: the 80B had the flatter speed/residency response (F-004: 0.384 vs 0.50-0.58)
explanandum.no_imported_thresholds: no pooled-SD threshold, no CV threshold, no p-value

store_read.windows: per-thread handles opened with FILE_FLAG_NO_BUFFERING | FILE_FLAG_OVERLAPPED; 4096-aligned slice reads; several overlapped reads in flight per handle; synchronous fallback only when no handle or event is available (recorded per read in the trace flags)
store_read.recorded_per_launch: store-open line (budget, 16 shards, 'cache dell'OS scavalcata', 'lettura asincrono'); diag manifests: read_mode requested/effective, direct_io=1, pretouch=0, cache_shards

diagnostic.name: natural-language
diagnostic.split_rationale: repository rule 'tune on dev, claim on eval' (workloads/README.md); nothing in EXP-022 is tuned on traces, and EXP-007 already holds natural-language EVAL runs of both models at >= 1.5 GiB

workloads.note: the trace tool accepts only versioned workloads, so the diagnostic blocks use natural-language v1 EVAL (the EXP-022 diagnostic workload), while the explanandum is measured on the untraced default benchmark prompt; the traced-slope agreement gate links the two

diskbench.role: device-level calibration only, not an emulator of the expert store. The store issues overlapped (asynchronous) uncached reads from per-thread handles, several in flight per handle, inside per-layer waves. `argine diskbench --kinds direct` issues one blocking uncached ReadFile per Python thread (FILE_FLAG_NO_BUFFERING, no FILE_FLAG_OVERLAPPED) at random 4096-aligned offsets. It reproduces only: uncached/direct reads, alignment, slice size and a controlled number of concurrent reads. It does NOT reproduce the store's `asincrono` semantics, its wave structure or its offsets. `moe` mode is not used.
diskbench.b_mix: B_mix(N) = sum bytes / sum (bytes / B(slice, N)), bytes = reads_per_token x slice
diskbench.telemetry: each diskbench run gets ARGINE_HOME = raw/diskbench/argine-home (created by the harness BEFORE the first run, so argine.util.app_dir never imports another history into it); diskbench's telemetry line therefore lands in raw/diskbench/argine-home/logs/runs.jsonl and is copied into raw/diskbench/records.jsonl; stdout/stderr go to raw/diskbench/logs/run-NN.log

spec.permutation_rule: round r (1-based) of block B: cells in canonical order, then random.Random(SEEDS[B] * 100 + r).shuffle(cells); the expanded orders are stored in the freeze spec and re-derived by --check

outcome_taxonomy.precedence: INVALID > STORE_RESIDENCY_ABORT > NON_COMPLETION > VALID (tools/exp022_run.classify, unchanged; store aborts are causally neutral, never 'infeasible')

eligibility.performance_cell: 3 of 3 scheduled launches VALID; otherwise the cell is NOT EVALUABLE for every decision; categorical outcomes are reported; numeric values of VALID launches may be shown labelled DESCRIPTIVE ONLY (for 2 VALID launches the centre is the two-value mean, labelled as such) and never feed a candidate or lifecycle decision
eligibility.diagnostic_launch: outcome VALID, manifest publication_quality true, trace complete over the workload, budget_violations == 0, node intervals disjoint and node residency <= T in every eligible decode graph, at least one eligible decode graph
eligibility.diagnostic_cell: 2 of 2 scheduled launches eligible (EXP-022 A1 precedent); otherwise every mechanism decision that needs the cell is NOT EVALUABLE
eligibility.diskbench_comparison: all 3 round values VALID for every (slice, readers) cell the comparison needs

accounting.kind: BOUND DECOMPOSITION ONLY (verified on existing EXP-022 traces 2026-10-15; an exact T = C + E_r + E_nr identity is NOT frozen)
accounting.eligible_decode_graph: graph g with n_tokens == 1 whose next graph g+1 is also a decode graph in the same workload request (warm-up and flush-sentinel segments excluded)
accounting.T_g: t0(g+1) - t0(g), t0 = the graph's earliest router (R record) timestamp
accounting.Res_g: sum over the graph's MoE nodes of (ready - start), thread-0 view; nodes must be disjoint (checked)
accounting.N_g: T_g - Res_g: exact; NON-RESIDENCY (compute-inclusive) time, NOT pure compute: non-MoE layers, attention, Gated DeltaNet, MoE matmul outside residency, sampling, synchronisation outside the store, tracing cost
accounting.reads_of_g: store reads (I records) issued in [t0(g), t0(g+1))
accounting.U_all: union of [issue, complete] over reads_of_g (complete may be an upper bound)
accounting.U_ex: union of [issue, complete] over reads_of_g with exact completion only
accounting.E_r: E_r_lo = |U_ex ∩ ResU_g| <= E_r <= E_r_hi = |U_all ∩ ResU_g|, ResU_g = union of node intervals
accounting.E_nr: E_nr = Res_g - E_r, so E_nr_lo = Res_g - E_r_hi <= E_nr <= E_nr_hi = Res_g - E_r_lo
accounting.unions: read intervals overlap heavily (mean concurrency 6-9 in EXP-022 samples): unions, never sums of latencies
accounting.M_g: sum of aligned store-read bytes of reads_of_g (a wait on another thread's read is an access, not a read)
accounting.per_launch: means over eligible decode graphs: T, N, Res, E_r_lo/hi, E_nr_lo/hi, M; N/T = sum N / sum T; q_lo/hi = sum E_r_lo/hi / sum M; m = mean M / F; depth = sum read latency / sum |U_all|

spec.counterfactual: DESCRIPTIVE ACCOUNTING ONLY, not a causal intervention, no significance. Traced cell means per (model, point). For a term X in {N, E_r, E_nr}: X80(P2) is replaced by X80(P1) * X30(P2) / X30(P1), the other 80B P2 terms stay observed, T80'(P2) = N + E_r + E_nr; for X = M the 80B P2 read bytes are rescaled the same way and E_r80(P2) is scaled with them (q held). beta80' uses the observed T80(P1). 'Moves beta80 toward beta30' means |beta80' - beta30| < |beta80 - beta30| on traced betas. Bounded terms are evaluated at both admissible bound versions (lo: E_r = E_r_lo, E_nr = Res - E_r_lo; hi: E_r = E_r_hi, E_nr = Res - E_r_hi); a directional statement counts only if both versions move beta80 toward beta30.

gate.beta_traced: per model, from traced decode T (launch means) at P1 and P2: beta = (ln T_P2 - ln T_P1) / (ln x_P1 - ln x_P2); point from cell means, envelope over the 2 x 2 launch pairings
gate.FAIL: sign(delta_beta_traced) differs from sign(primary delta_beta), OR the traced envelopes overlap while the primary outcome is REPRODUCED or REVERSED
gate.NOT EVALUABLE: primary explanandum NOT EVALUABLE, or a P1/P2 diagnostic cell of either model not 2/2 eligible
gate.effect: if the gate is not PASS every candidate test is NOT EVALUABLE; the untraced performance result stands; traced results are never primary throughput results

a.premise: historical EWS-fraction metric (EWS90 routed experts / total routed experts) reported separately
a.endpoint: m = decode store-read bytes / eligible decode graphs / F per diagnostic launch; e_a = (ln m_P2 - ln m_P1) / (ln x_P2 - ln x_P1), envelope over the 2 x 2 launch pairings
a.UNRESOLVED_first: the 4 e_a values do not all have the same sign, or some m <= 0
a.SUPPORTED: max |e_a|80 < min |e_a|30 AND the M counterfactual moves beta80 toward beta30 at both bounds
a.UNRESOLVED: otherwise (80B smaller without overlap but the counterfactual does not move beta80 toward beta30 at both bounds)
a.NOT EVALUABLE: a P1/P2 diagnostic cell not 2/2 eligible, or the gate is not PASS
a.wording: consistent with routing concentration contributing to the regime difference

b.device: B_mix per model and round; comparison k: 80B at 2N vs 30B at N, N in {2, 4, 8}; favours 80B if min over rounds B_mix80 > max over rounds B_mix30, disfavours if max80 < min30, else indeterminate; device FAVOURS if all three favour, DISFAVOURS if all three disfavour, else INDETERMINATE
b.trace: q = E_r / M (bounded); at a point 80B LOWER if max(80B q_hi over eligible launches) < min(30B q_lo), HIGHER if min(80B q_lo) > max(30B q_hi), else indeterminate; trace LOWER/HIGHER if so at both P1 and P2, else INDETERMINATE
b.WEAKENED: (FAVOURS and trace INDETERMINATE) or (device INDETERMINATE and LOWER)
b.UNRESOLVED: device and trace contradict (FAVOURS+HIGHER or DISFAVOURS+LOWER), a relevant traced depth (P1/P2, both models) outside [2, 16], or any other evaluable combination
b.NOT EVALUABLE: required diagnostic cells not eligible, diskbench comparison incomplete, or gate not PASS
b.limitation: diskbench does not reproduce store asincrono behaviour; device evidence is device-level only

c.counters: whole-process store counters (commit/decommit/lock/read) are DIAGNOSTIC ONLY
c.FALSIFIED AS STATED: at BOTH P1 and P2, in BOTH eligible 80B diagnostic launches: E_nr_hi < E_r_lo
c.WEAKENED: the falsification condition holds at exactly one of P1, P2; OR at both P1 and P2 max over 80B launches of E_nr_hi / Res <= min over 30B launches of E_nr_lo / Res (the 80B is demonstrably not more non-read dominated than the 30B)
c.SUPPORTED: NOT REACHABLE with existing instrumentation (E_nr also contains barrier waits and hit lookups); no positive bookkeeping rule exists; inability to support (c) does not make it false
c.NOT EVALUABLE: required diagnostic cells not eligible or gate not PASS

d.endpoint: N / T per launch: non-residency (compute-inclusive) time share; never 'pure compute'; Gated DeltaNet itself is not isolated
d.SUPPORTED: at P1 AND P2: min(80B N/T) > max(30B N/T) AND the N counterfactual moves beta80 toward beta30
d.FALSIFIED AS STATED: at BOTH P1 and P2: max(80B N/T) < min(30B N/T)
d.NOT EVALUABLE: required diagnostic cells not eligible or gate not PASS

routing_taxonomy.historical_ews_fraction: EWS90 routed experts / total routed experts (the literal 'smaller EWS fraction'); EXP-007 values are historical/descriptive premises only
routing_taxonomy.byte_weighted_variant: EWS90 bytes / store bytes: NOT equivalent (expert size varies by layer in both models); reported separately, labelled
routing_taxonomy.pressure_normalized_predictor: EWS90 bytes / F with exact per-layer expert sizes: a predictor under budget/F normalization; not the historical statement and not a decision endpoint
routing_taxonomy.mechanism_consequence: candidate (a) endpoint m and its elasticity e_a (see CANDIDATE_RULES['a'])

lifecycle.SUPPORTED: explanandum REPRODUCED AND gate PASS AND at least one of (a), (b), (c), (d) SUPPORTED under its own frozen rule (others may be anything)
lifecycle.FALSIFIED: explanandum REPRODUCED AND gate PASS AND all four candidates FALSIFIED AS STATED under their own rules; UNRESOLVED, WEAKENED or NOT EVALUABLE never count as falsified
lifecycle.INCONCLUSIVE: every other case (explanandum NOT EVALUABLE, NOT DISTINGUISHED or REVERSED; gate failure; no supported candidate while at least one candidate is not falsified)

spec.not_reproduced_template: EXPLANANDUM NOT REPRODUCED. At matched budget/F (P1→P2, 4 generation threads, current runtime) the 80B's pressure-response exponent was {relation} the 30B's. The historical regime difference did not reproduce in the matched-F region on the current runtime. This does not retrospectively falsify EXP-006 or alter F-004. Those were measured over different budget/F regions on earlier binaries and remain valid descriptions of those sessions. The candidate-mechanism hypothesis is INCONCLUSIVE: its object was absent at matched budget/F, so the candidates could not be discriminated against it. Secondary results are reported descriptively.

rq009.ANSWERED: explanandum evaluable and all four candidates resolved (SUPPORTED, WEAKENED or FALSIFIED AS STATED)
rq009.PARTIALLY ANSWERED: explanandum evaluable and at least one candidate resolved; the Unknown text is narrowed to the remaining candidates
rq009.otherwise: RQ-009 remains PARTIALLY ANSWERED with a data note; it never regresses
rq009.not_reproduced_note: the historical slope difference is not reproduced at matched budget/F; consistent with a normalization/region difference
rq009.open_questions_edit: OPEN_QUESTIONS.md is not modified by the freeze; it is updated only at closure

reporting.secondary: R = ms/token80 / ms/token30 at P1, P2, P3 (cell medians, launch ranges), descriptive
reporting.sensitivity: 30B at 12 threads: beta (P1->P2) and envelope, operational comparison with the 80B at 4 threads; descriptive, not part of the primary decision
reporting.p3: P3 performance and mechanism values are descriptive

tracing_limitations: traced and untraced launches are never pooled; traced T is used only for beta_traced, shares and bounds
no tracing-overhead claim outside EXP-024's tested condition
node residency is the thread-0 view; reads of other threads are counted by interval
some completions are upper bounds, so E_r, E_nr, q and depth are bounds or bound-derived
N is non-residency time and includes tracing cost
known_limitations: observational cross-model comparison: no randomization across models; architecture, quantization, expert count, slice sizes, routing and F differ together; only run order is randomized
4 generation threads is the 80B's EXP-027 optimum at 4 GiB; the 30B sensitivity at 12 threads covers P1/P2 only
the 80B is below every whole-layer size at P3 (672 MiB < 728 MiB): layer fit changes with pressure there
one session per block, one workload per block type; the diagnostic workload differs from the performance prompt
2 diagnostic launches per cell give weak non-overlap evidence
diskbench is a device-level calibration, not a store emulator; 80B 2N vs 30B N is about 5% more bytes in flight on the 80B side (mean read 499,712 vs 952,320 B)
the matched-F region (P1->P2 = 3.92F->1.47F) differs from the historical 80B region (5.97F->2.24F)
causal language is limited to 'consistent with' / 'falsified as stated'
